title: Z-SPAN per-city recon JSON
description: Canonical shape for a `state_scaffolding/<state>/discovery/<county>/<city>.json` recon file. The 14 top-level fields capture everything a downstream parser-scaffolder needs to produce a working parser without re-doing recon. Canonical source: 01_Project_Overview/NATIONAL_SCALING.md § Output schema. Worked examples: 13 Arizona cities at state_scaffolding/arizona/discovery/<county>/<city>.json.

city_name.description: The city's display name as it appears on its own .gov / canonical website. NOT slugged; NOT lowercased. Examples: 'Kingman', 'Lake Havasu City', 'St. Johns', 'Dewey-Humboldt'.

county.description: The county name with trailing ' County' suffix. Examples: 'Mohave County', 'Yavapai County', 'Apache County'.

state.description: Full state name (NOT the 2-letter abbreviation). Examples: 'Arizona', 'Nevada', 'New Mexico'.

official_url.description: The city's canonical .gov or equivalent official website. Source of truth for council rosters, election notices, calendar links. Per D-118, alternate-TLD probing is PROHIBITED — confirm the .gov directly, do not investigate alternate domains.

calendar_url.description: The human-visible URL where the meeting calendar / agenda archive lives. May or may not equal the machine-scrapable API endpoint (see calendar_api_url).

calendar_api_url.description: Machine-scrapable API endpoint for SPA-class vendors (CivicClerk, PrimeGov, etc.) where calendar_url is a single-page-application shell and meeting data lives at a separate API path. Discoverable via JavaScript bundle introspection (see NATIONAL_SCALING.md § bundle introspection rule). NULL for non-SPA vendors (Granicus / Legistar legacy / CivicPlus AgendaCenter / static HTML).

calendar_format.description: Canonical vendor enum. Per NATIONAL_SCALING.md § calendar_format strict rule: use 'unknown' when neither the fingerprinter NOR your inspection can identify the platform OR when inspection was blocker-induced empty. Use 'custom' only with POSITIVE evidence of hand-rolled HTML on the city's own domain. Blocker-induced empty resolves to 'unknown', NOT 'custom'. The deterministic fingerprinter at parsers/scripts/vendor_fingerprint.py classifies ~63% of cities in microseconds.

youtube_channel_url.description: YouTube-domain-only channel URL (after F5 canonical-form normalization — strip /live, /streams, /videos, /featured, /playlists, /community, /about, /shorts, /channels tab suffixes before emit). NULL when no active council-meeting channel exists. NON-YouTube archives (Granicus MP4, Swagit, Vimeo, SharePoint, ASX/RTMP, embedded HTML5) MUST emit NULL here; surface non-YouTube archives in research_notes. Trust-rank: (1) .gov-linked, (2) WebSearch-discovered with active council-meeting content evidence, (3) NULL.

ocd_division_id.description: Open Civic Data division ID for the place. Format: 'ocd-division/country:us/state:<lc>/place:<slug>'. NULL when no OCD entry exists for this place (rare; small unincorporated places).

role.description: Canonical role label. Normalize variants (Vice-Mayor → Vice Mayor; Councilmember → Council Member).

seat_id.description: Per F16 seat_id convention: 'mayor' / 'vice_mayor' for those roles; 'seat_N' (N=1..) ONLY with explicit numbered-seat DOM evidence; NULL for generic at-large council members.

term_started.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD when the member's current term began. NULL when not stated on the .gov roster page.

term_ends.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD when the member's current term ends. NULL when not stated on the .gov roster page.

council_members.description: Council member roster verified verbatim against the .gov roster page. Empty array when no roster is discoverable (record the limitation in research_notes).

next_election_date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD of the next regularly-scheduled council election. Per F21, fetch the .gov homepage + scan for Notice-of-Election PDFs before emitting null. NULL only when neither the .gov nor authoritative sources surface a date.

term_length_years.description: Council member term length in years (typically 2 or 4). NULL when the roster page doesn't state it.

next_election_seats_up.description: Specific seat IDs up in the next election (e.g., ['seat_2', 'seat_4', 'mayor']). Empty array when the Notice-of-Election PDF says generic 'N Council Seats' without enumerating specific seat IDs (F16 null-for-at-large discipline).

population.description: Most recent population estimate from the city's own About page (preferred) OR the US Census ACS (fallback). NULL when neither source surfaces a value. Do NOT use Wikipedia 2020 Census as the easy-hallucination fallback — Codex catches this trap (the .gov's stated population almost always supersedes a stale Wikipedia number).

research_notes.description: Free-text research notes summarizing what was witnessed during recon. Required even when all fields populate cleanly — explains the recon decisions a future maintainer will want to re-verify. Includes: vendor fingerprint witnesses, fallback paths taken, ambiguities flagged for operator review, F-finding references. Synthesis-corrections (changes made by the verifier panel to Codex's initial output) MUST be documented here with '=== SYNTHESIS FIX YYYY-MM-DD — FNN reason ===' separators.

evidence.description: Free-text evidence describing what was observed about the flagged domain. Per D-118, this evidence MUST come from non-HTTP sources (Google search snippets, WHOIS, DNS, crt.sh Certificate Transparency, Wayback Machine) — alternate-TLD HTTP probing is PROHIBITED.

discovered.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD when the domain was discovered + flagged during recon.

flagged_domains.description: Catalog of suspicious / confusable / hijack / squat domains discovered incidentally during recon (e.g., townofkearny.com 301-hijacks to a Spanish winery brand). Populated by incidental observation on the official source we're already touching — NOT by deliberate alternate-TLD HTTP probing (D-118 prohibition). Empty array when no flagged domains surface during recon.
